column1: # Rate calibrated 2026-08-17 against two real read-throughs: 547 words in 3:05
# and 700 words in 3:47 — 177 and 185 wpm. Planning rate is 130, that
# measurement minus ~28%, deliberately at the cautious end: overrunning is
# unrecoverable and finishing early is not. Everything below is sized at 130.
# `demo` rows score at the lower DEMO_WPM — on a live edit you talk around
# typing and pause while the room reads the error. The four demos are 9:15,
# 20% of the slot, and before these rows existed the tool could not see one
# `stub` rows are v2 slides that do not exist yet, carrying their planned cap
# so `make timing` measures the deck we INTEND rather than the deck we have.
# ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH for durations. The plan quotes this file, never the
# reverse: three drafts running, hand-carried arithmetic in the plan drifted in
# the same direction every time (Part 8/C10, C12).
# Integration UNSETTLED x highest downstream cost. Cut #5 merges the
# connectives and quantifiers slides if the read-through measures long.
# ── Act 4 · Scala 3 — 8:30 · has never fit any budget; measured 10:36 in v1 ─
# ── Cut or merged (kept so the reason survives) ────────────────────────────

#                   Unrepresentable slide and the close are the two that work
